description: This file contains extension methods for IOrchardHelper to facilitate loading and querying ContentItems in OrchardCore CMS, including methods to get content by handle, id, version, and to query recent content items by type.

classes.name: ContentOrchardHelperExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for IOrchardHelper to simplify content item retrieval and querying in OrchardCore.

methods.name: GetContentItemIdByHandleAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a content item ID asynchronously based on its handle.

methods.name: GetContentItemByHandleAsync
methods.description: Loads a content item asynchronously by its handle, with optional versioning.

methods.name: GetContentItemByIdAsync
methods.description: Loads a content item asynchronously by its ID, with optional versioning.

methods.name: GetContentItemsByIdAsync
methods.description: Loads multiple content items asynchronously by their IDs.

methods.name: GetContentItemByVersionIdAsync
methods.description: Loads a specific version of a content item asynchronously by version ID.

methods.name: QueryContentItemsAsync
methods.description: Executes a query to retrieve content items based on a provided filter function.

methods.name: GetRecentContentItemsByContentTypeAsync
methods.description: Retrieves recent published content items of a specific type, limited by max count.
